articles.title: Ocean cold snaps can imperil sea turtles. Rescuers can help
articles.snippet: Climate-driven ocean changes are stranding thousands of sea turtles on beaches, too cold to swim or eat. Special hospitals give some a fighting chance.
articles.summary: Climate change is causing ocean cold snaps that strand thousands of sea turtles on beaches, leaving them too cold to swim or eat. Special hospitals are now helping to rescue and treat these turtles to give them a fighting chance.
